description: This Swift source file defines the 'GatewayRemoteConfig' enum and associated static methods for handling remote gateway configuration, including resolving transport types, URLs, tokens, and normalizing WebSocket URLs. It is used for interpreting and managing configuration data for remote gateways in an application.

methods.name: resolveTransport
methods.description: Resolves the transport method ('direct' or 'ssh') from a nested dictionary structure representing configuration data.

methods.name: resolveUrlString
methods.description: Extracts and trims the URL string from the configuration data if present.

methods.name: resolveTokenValue
methods.description: Determines the token value state (missing, plaintext, unsupported) from the configuration data.

methods.name: resolveTokenString
methods.description: Returns the token string if available and supported, otherwise nil.

methods.name: resolveGatewayUrl
methods.description: Resolves and returns a normalized URL object for the gateway based on configuration data.

methods.name: normalizeGatewayUrlString
methods.description: Normalizes the gateway URL string, returning its absolute string if valid.

methods.name: normalizeGatewayUrl
methods.description: Converts a raw URL string into a validated, potentially modified URL object with specific scheme and host rules.

methods.name: defaultPort
methods.description: Returns the default port for a given URL, based on its scheme ('wss' or 'ws').
